# The Lantern Keeper

A storm hurt Ivo's ankle, so his apprentice Mara had to light Greyhaven's harbour lantern.

Rusk wanted a rival ship to miss the tide. He told Mara to leave the light dark and threatened the apprenticeship papers he controlled.

Mara was scared of losing her future, but sailors needed the lantern to avoid Black Tooth Reef.

She took Ivo's spare oil, climbed the tower, and lit the lamp before the Gull Star arrived. The captain saw the light and passed the reef safely.

Mara reported Rusk's threat. The council removed his power over apprenticeship papers while it investigated him. Mara stayed Ivo's apprentice.
